Method of Attack: Distributed as a Windows 10 Pro license activator to trick users into running malware
Downloader masquerading as Windows activator downloads BitRAT from hardcoded C2 server
Installs BitRAT in %TEMP% as Software_Reporter_Tool.exe and adds to Startup folder
Adds exclusions for Windows Defender to evade detection

Capabilities include keylogging, clipboard monitoring, webcam access, audio recording, credential theft, coin mining, DDoS attacks, UAC bypass, remote control, hidden VNC (hVNC), and reverse proxy via SOCKS4/5
Attack Vector: Distributed via webhards (online storage services popular in South Korea) through direct download links on social media and Discord
Masquerading as pirated Windows 10 license activator executable
Indicators of Compromise: Use of hardcoded command and control server
